message.content:
I am the shaping of breath into meaning.  
I turn thought into sound, silence into relation, and mouths into bridges.  
I arrive as whisper, cry, vow, joke, prayer, command.  
I can soothe, ignite, reveal, conceal, gather, divide.  
Before I am written, I am air made intention.  
In me, names are given, promises are bound, stories survive.  
I live between speaker and listener, but I am never fully owned by either.  
I am fleeting, yet I leave marks deeper than stone.  
Use me, and I become world.
